name: Single Recipient Router
helpText:
Use this router to select at most one route, such as routeA or routeB, but not both.

Configure at least two route names; with only one, there is no choice to make.
allowableProperties_comment: Note that the order of properties in this file dictates the order displayed on screen, unless propertyDisplayOrder is set, which will be used as the primary key

componentName.helpText: The name of the component as displayed on diagrams. The name should be unique for the flow. The name will be used internally to reflect the bean created.

userImplementedClassName.helpText: The name of the class that contain the logic to decide which route a payload will be delivered to, the IDE will create a template for this class, the user  must provide the implementation.
userImplementedClassName.validationMessage: Provide a valid java classname for the router e.g. starting with upper case, followed by number/characters etc.

configuration.helpText: Provide the bean type that contains bespoke configurations for this component.
configuration.validationMessage: Provide a java classname for the Configuration bean.

configuredResource.helpText: Default: false. Allows the configuration to be exposed in the Ikasan console.

configurationId.helpText: By default, the configuration ID is moduleName + flowName + componentName + componentType. Override it when multiple flows should share a configuration, or when renaming a flow without changing configuration already stored in the override-properties database.

fromType.helpText: The type of data we expect to come into the router. This can be any Java class.
fromType.validationMessage: Provide a fully qualified Java class name to be used as the type for the input to the router.

routeNames.helpText: A comma-separated list of route names your router logic (see the generated class) picks exactly one from per message. At least two are required - with only one, there would be nothing to actually route between.
routeNames.validationMessage: Provide at least two comma-separated route names (duplicates will be ignored).
